request.description:
Get all rooms for the user

### Returns
`rooms (SQLChatManager.Rooms)`: list of all rooms that user_id has

Create a room through the `ChatHistoryManager` interface

### Body:

- `room_name` (`String`): name of room
    
- `user_id (int)`: user id of the creator of the room
    

### Returns:

- `room_id (int)`: ID of the new room
    

Throws an exception if cannot create the room

request.description:
Helper function to post user prompt to the bot.

### Params: 
`room_id (int)`: room id to message to

### Body:
`user_prompt (String)`: user prompt to the chatting agent
`user_id (int)`:
user id to the chatting agent
`prompt_type (String)`:
type of prompt, can either be `'CONVERSATION'` or `'QUERY'`.

### Returns: 
* `image (String)`: image of the chat response (in a cloudinary url)
* `text (String)`: text response of the AI agent.
